scope: Internal two-pass current-cap candidate preparation and guarded local installation; no UI/provider/writer/cap increase.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Use empty-ledger and one-receipt encrypted goldens, plus test-encrypted finance logical positive.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Before finish current identity is unchanged; both complete passes match; guarded install/new-store reopen preserves all represented fields and exact receipt bytes.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Test-encrypt split-domain-header, split-end-header and split-end-payload preserving declared frameSizes.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Both passes accept only after real FINAL/EOF; borrowed receipt boundaries do not change bytes.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Run frame negatives; test-encrypt logical end-in-message, end-transcript, orphan-receipt, duplicate-key and escaped-equivalent-key.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Reject in either pass with no candidate or current mutation.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Replace one-receipt bytes with rgba9-plain-invalid_filter; recompute descriptor, counts, transcript and actual test encryption.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Native complete image validation rejects despite valid authentication and hashes.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Use beyond-legacy-count plus metadata boundary and exact candidate encoded-size boundary cases from existing native tests.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Reject current app or candidate over-limit cases before candidate transfer; no raised cap or full-snapshot allocation to calculate capacity.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Edit target during pass 1, between passes or before install; also repeat revision under new incarnation, swap namespace or key.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Original opaque binding rejects; intervening state survives. No recapture/provisioning; ordinary GC cannot remove pinned candidate bytes.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Substitute, mutate, truncate or append to owned input before/during pass 2, including another otherwise valid archive.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Ownership/digest/count or full authentication rejects; no candidate transfer; preserve unknown replacement.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Inject read/close/cancel in acquisition and either pass, including after sink completion; inject preparation finish/write/sync/reopen failure.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: No successful candidate escapes a later failure; owned cleanup preserves current and unknown data.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Reuse after finish/discard/failed owner install; try foreign receiver; inject pre/postpublication cancellation and confirmed/uncertain rollback.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Reuse rejects; foreign receiver cannot consume rightful owner; existing truthful recovery and ownership-transfer rules remain.

requiredScenarios.trigger: Fail existing device-key lookup before pass 1 and again before installation.
requiredScenarios.requiredOutcome: Reject/lock with zero provisioning, empty initialization or existing-key replacement.

evidenceRequirements: Record manifest/source/build/runtime hashes, methods, actual outcomes and skipped/not_run reasons for each platform.
Plain logical fixtures require actual test-only authenticated framing; preserve frameSizes and finalFrame. No fixture existence or inherited reader/candidate result proves this adapter.
Bind pass summaries to exact ciphertext SHA/count and record successful close/FINAL/EOF before candidate finish.
No UI/provider/account/new-key onboarding, process-death, larger-capacity or aggregate-memory claim from this internal slice.
